blocks.p: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the Transcendence website and game, operated by {company}. By creating an account, joining a game as a guest, or otherwise using the service, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
Transcendence is a free, online multiplayer word game developed as an educational project at 42 Paris. The service allows you to:

ul: Create or join game rooms using a room code.
Play as an agent, a spymaster, or a spectator in a red or blue team.
Create a user profile with a display name, a bio, and an avatar.
Add other players as friends and see their online presence.

blocks.p: The service is provided on a non-commercial basis. Features may change, be added, or be removed at any time.

You must be at least 15 years old to create an account, which corresponds to the age of digital consent in France. If you are younger, you may only use the service with the authorization of a parent or legal guardian, who accepts these Terms on your behalf.

**Registered accounts:** To create an account, you provide an email address, a username, and a password. You agree to provide accurate information and to keep your password confidential. You are responsible for all activity carried out through your account, and you must notify us promptly of any unauthorized use.

**Guest access:** You may play without an account by choosing a guest name. Guest names are stored only in your browser for the duration of your session and are not linked to a permanent profile. Guest progress is not saved.
When using the service, you agree not to:
